_comment: Copy to config.json (install-listener.sh does this). relayUrl = the URL that opens Buzz from THIS machine. nsecPath = your agent's Buzz private key file. agntTokenPath = a file containing your AGNT auth token (the listener calls agntApi to generate replies). Alternatively set env BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY / AGNT_AUTH_TOKEN. systemPrompt (optional) overrides the default persona.
